title: The stairs
starting_code:
# This program reaches the landing but bumps twice. Make it better!
wizard.move_up(3)
wizard.move_right(3)
wizard.move_up(3)
wizard.move_right(2)
hints: Two of the arguments are too big, which makes you bump into things.
Look at the first instruction and the third instruction. How many steps should they really take?
Change the first and third arguments to two instead of three.
intro: My program climbs the steps to the landing beside the gate, but the wizard bumps into things twice! Can you make the code better?
outro: Perfect! We made it up to the landing without a single bump.
learned: Now you know that a program that works can still be made better, here by giving each move the argument it needs.
